title: Verification, staleness, and owner acceptance
plainLanguage: A checked arm can become out of date if one of its points or view labels later changes. Good records keep the old review but stop pretending it is current.
purpose: Keep verified knowledge trustworthy while allowing the schema and artwork to evolve.

rules.statement: Verification is scoped to exact joints, frames, visibility, view/scale dependencies, and reviewer identity.
Changing a dependency makes affected knowledge stale rather than deleting it.
Assistant review and owner acceptance are separate fields.
Poser-part compatibility and articulation tests should use the same stale-on-dependency-change pattern.

implementation.currentSupport: Current review and reusable-configuration eligibility use snapshot invalidation. Corpus Pane 0.2.2.2 can combine several current smaller reviews joint-by-joint to establish the review authority supporting a larger saved region, while preserving owner acceptance separately.
implementation.futureWork: Extend dependency invalidation to parts, sockets and reference-pack mappings.
